content:
cd $SRC/kamailio
export CC_OPT="${CFLAGS}"
export LD_EXTRA_OPTS="${CFLAGS}"
sed -i 's/int main(/int main2(/g' ./src/main.c
export MEMPKG=sys
make Q=verbose || true
cd src
mkdir objects && find . -name "*.o" -exec cp {} ./objects/ \;
ar -r libkamilio.a ./objects/*.o
cd ../
$CC $CFLAGS $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE ./misc/fuzz/fuzz_uri.c -o $OUT/fuzz_uri     -DFAST_LOCK -D__CPU_i386 ./src/libkamilio.a     -I./src/ -I./src/core/parser -ldl -lresolv -lm
$CC $CFLAGS $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE ./misc/fuzz/fuzz_parse_msg.c -o $OUT/fuzz_parse_msg     -DFAST_LOCK -D__CPU_i386 ./src/libkamilio.a     -I./src/ -I./src/core/parser -ldl -lresolv -lm
